en.title: Network & Partnerships
en.summary: A curated network of cities, operators, founders, investors, speakers, and institutions active in China-LATAM technology exchange.
en.imageAlt: Professionals networking after a cross-border technology event.
en.metaDescription: Explore the LATAM China Tech network of city partnerships, featured speakers, and ecosystem collaborators.
en.bodyHtml:
The network exists to make cross-border collaboration easier to start and easier to sustain. We connect institutions, companies, and operators around shared commercial, policy, and innovation priorities.

City partnerships and featured speakers are managed as living ecosystem assets, not one-off contact lists.

sections.title: City partnerships
sections.bodyHtml: We support city-to-city technology exchange, delegation design, innovation programming, and corridor positioning for municipal and regional partners.

sections.title: Featured speakers
sections.bodyHtml: LATAM China Tech curates founders, investors, operators, policymakers, and technical leaders for conferences, missions, panels, and private briefings.

br.title: Rede e parcerias
br.summary: Uma rede curada de cidades, operadores, founders, investidores, palestrantes e instituicoes ativas no intercambio tecnologico China-LATAM.
br.imageAlt: Profissionais fazendo networking depois de um evento de tecnologia cross-border.
br.metaTitle: Rede e parcerias | LATAM China Tech
br.metaDescription: Explore a rede da LATAM China Tech com parcerias entre cidades, palestrantes e colaboradores de ecossistema.
br.bodyHtml:
A rede existe para tornar a colaboracao cross-border mais facil de iniciar e sustentar. Conectamos instituicoes, empresas e operadores em torno de prioridades comerciais, politicas e de inovacao.

Parcerias entre cidades e speakers em destaque sao geridos como ativos vivos do ecossistema, nao como listas pontuais de contatos.

sections.title: Parcerias entre cidades
sections.bodyHtml: Apoiamos intercambio tecnologico cidade-a-cidade, desenho de delegacoes, programacao de inovacao e posicionamento de corredor para parceiros municipais e regionais.

sections.title: Speakers em destaque
sections.bodyHtml: A LATAM China Tech cura founders, investidores, operadores, policy makers e liderancas tecnicas para conferencias, missoes, paineis e briefings privados.

cn.title: 网络与伙伴关系
cn.summary: 由城市、运营者、创始人、投资人、演讲嘉宾和机构组成的精选网络，服务于中国-拉美科技交流。
cn.imageAlt: 跨境科技活动结束后，专业人士正在交流。
cn.metaTitle: 网络与伙伴关系 | LATAM China Tech
cn.metaDescription: 探索 LATAM China Tech 的城市合作、精选演讲嘉宾和生态伙伴网络。
cn.bodyHtml:
这个网络旨在让跨境合作更容易开始，也更容易持续。我们围绕共同的商业、政策和创新重点连接机构、企业和运营者。

城市伙伴关系和精选演讲嘉宾会作为持续更新的生态资产管理，而不是一次性联系人列表。

sections.title: 城市伙伴关系
sections.bodyHtml: 我们支持城市之间的科技交流、代表团设计、创新活动策划，以及市级和区域伙伴的走廊定位。

sections.title: 精选演讲嘉宾
sections.bodyHtml: LATAM China Tech 为会议、商务考察、圆桌和私密简报策划创始人、投资人、运营者、政策专家和技术领袖。
